statement: PulteGroup, Inc.'s Texas home sale revenues increased 18% in Q3 2024 compared with Q3 2023 due to a 23% increase in closings partially offset by a 4% decrease in average selling price.

PulteGroup, Inc.'s Texas home sale revenues increased 7% for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 compared with the prior year period due to a 6% increase in closings combined with a 1% increase in average selling price.
Expedia Group, Inc.'s general and administrative expense increased $35 million and $23 million during the three and nine months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same periods in 2023.

The increase in general and administrative expense was primarily due to a $51 million acceleration in stock-compensation expense related to the departure of the Vice Chairman, partially offset by lower personnel costs from cost-saving initiatives.
Phillips 66’s Midstream segment includes Transportation and natural gas liquids (NGL) businesses, with the NGL business impacted by NGL and natural gas prices.
The weighted-average NGL price was $0.64 per gallon during the third quarter of 2024, compared with $0.67 per gallon during the third quarter of 2023.
The Henry Hub natural gas price was $2.09 per million British thermal units (MMBtu) during the third quarter of 2024, compared with $2.58 per MMBtu during the third quarter of 2023.
Midstream adjusted EBITDA is ahead of 2024 guidance despite weaker natural gas and NGL prices.
OCCIDENTAL PETROLEUM CORP /DE/ Midstream and marketing segment losses for the three months ended March 31, 2025 were $77 million, compared to $33 million for the same period in 2024.

The increase in Midstream and marketing segment results for Q1 2025 reflected higher gas margins from transportation capacity optimization in the Permian and higher sulfur prices at Al Hosn, partially offset by lower margins from crude sales timing impacts.

Agilent Technologies, Inc.'s revenue and operating results could be adversely affected by fluctuations in research and development budgets at customers, including pharmaceutical companies, laboratories, universities, and government agencies.

Demand for Agilent's products and services depends on capital spending policies of customers, which are influenced by public policy spending priorities, available resources, mergers and consolidations, and government funding policies.
The timing and amount of revenue from customers relying on government funding or research may vary significantly due to changes in spending authorizations and budgetary priorities.
Amcor plc's Flexibles portfolio volumes increased approximately 5% across all regions and product categories.
Apple Inc.'s Services revenue reached $24.2 billion in FY2024 Q3, representing an all-time record and a 14% year-over-year increase.
M&T Bank Corporation's cumulative upward deposit pricing beta approximated 55% from the first quarter of 2022 through the second quarter of 2024.
M&T Bank Corporation's cumulative downward deposit pricing beta from the third quarter of 2024 through the first quarter of 2025 approximated 54%.
Northern Trust tendered all 4.1 million of its Visa Class B shares in the Exchange Offer.
As of May 3, 2024, Northern Trust received 2.1 million Visa Class B-2 shares and 819.5 thousand Visa Class C shares from the Exchange Offer.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. repurchased $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of the Silver Lake Convertible Debt for $1.59 billion in cash on February 14, 2024.

The repurchase of Silver Lake Convertible Debt resulted in a $585 million loss on extinguishment, calculated as the excess of repurchase amount over carrying value of $593 million, offset by $8 million accrued interest.
The $585 million loss on extinguishment was recorded within Other Income (Expense) in the Consolidated Statements of Operations for FY2024.
APA Corp announced a significant cost reduction initiative in the first quarter of 2025, targeting over $350 million in annualized savings by the end of 2027.
The cost reduction initiative includes reducing overhead costs and improving field operating efficiencies.
APA Corp aims to drive sustainable cost savings for the long-term through its cost reduction initiative.
Assurant, Inc.'s Global Lifestyle net earned premiums, fees and other income increased $74.6 million, or 4%, to $2.18 billion for Second Quarter 2024 compared to Second Quarter 2023.

The increase in Global Lifestyle net earned premiums was primarily driven by Connected Living from mobile growth, including contributions from newly launched trade-in programs and global device protection programs.
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. recognized a gain on disposition of approximately $7.1 million from transferring control of data centers in FY2024 Q2.
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. contributed a data center valued at approximately $453 million to a joint venture with GI Partners in FY2024 Q2, receiving net proceeds of approximately $386 million.
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. recorded a provision for impairment on real estate investments of $168.3 million during FY2024 Q2.
Teradyne, Inc.'s Semiconductor Test segment revenues increased $166.7 million, or 8.5%, in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
The Robotics segment revenues decreased $10.4 million, or 2.8%, in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
Microsoft Corporation reported progress in reducing direct operational emissions (Scope 1 and 2) during fiscal year 2023, as noted in their Environmental Sustainability Report.

Microsoft Corporation is intensively working to address reductions in indirect emissions (Scope 3) and water use in datacenter operations, as these areas are not yet on track according to their FY2023 progress.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company excludes transformation program costs from non-GAAP financial measures because they are discrete costs related to specific transformation programs announced in 2017 and 2020.
Walmart Inc.'s Walmart U.S. segment invested in supply chain automation and utilized 162 distribution facilities for merchandise shipments in fiscal 2024.
Mohawk Industries, Inc.'s basic earnings per share for FY2024 was $8.18, and diluted earnings per share was $8.14.
Globe Life Inc.'s fixed maturities portfolio has a weighted average composite quality rating of A- as of March 31, 2025.
BBB-rated fixed maturities constitute 45% of Globe Life Inc.'s total portfolio at March 31, 2025.
Applied Materials, Inc. repurchased 4.1 million shares at an average price of $197.77 in the three months ended April 28, 2024.
Cboe Global Markets, Inc.'s Options segment operating income increased $11.9 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024 compared to the three months ended June 30, 2023.
The Options segment operating income increase was primarily due to an increase in revenues less cost of revenues, partially offset by an increase in operating expenses.
Options segment operating expenses increased $11.6 million for the three months ended June 30, 2024 compared to the three months ended June 30, 2023.
For the six months ended June 30, 2024, Options segment operating income increased $27.7 million compared to the six months ended June 30, 2023.
Options segment operating expenses increased $22.5 million for the six months ended June 30, 2024 compared to the six months ended June 30, 2023.
The Options segment revenue growth was driven by an 11% increase in index options ADV and a 3% increase in index options RPC.
American Tower Corporation's U.S. & Canada property segment SG&A decreased in FY2024 Q2 due to decreased personnel and related costs and decreased professional services costs.

American Tower Corporation's Asia-Pacific property segment SG&A increased in FY2024 Q2 due to increased professional services costs and an increase in bad debt expense, partially offset by lower canceled construction costs.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. used a portion of the net cash proceeds from the 2024 Worldpay Sale to repay borrowings under its commercial paper programs and reduce long-term debt.

The 2024 Worldpay Sale generated net cash proceeds of more than $12 billion for Fidelity National Information Services, Inc., after accounting for estimated closing adjustments, debt restructuring fees, taxes, and transaction costs.
Gilead Sciences, Inc. incurred restructuring charges totaling $527 million in FY2023 primarily due to changes in manufacturing strategy, including discontinuing certain facilities.
The restructuring charges included $381 million in write-offs of manufacturing assets, $89 million in write-offs of inventory, and $57 million in other costs.

A $479 million charge to Cost of goods sold, a $20 million charge to Research and development expenses, and a $28 million charge to Selling, general and administrative expenses were recorded on the Consolidated Statements of Income.
Globe Life Inc.'s American Income Life Division reported net sales of $192 million for the six months ended June 30, 2024, up from $165 million in the same period in the prior year.
The American Income Life Division's average monthly life premium issued per policy increased from $53 in the prior year to $57 for the six months ended June 30, 2024.
Lockheed Martin’s MFC net sales increased $1.2 billion, or 15%, for the nine months ended September 29, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
The increase in MFC net sales was primarily due to higher sales of $1.1 billion for tactical and strike missile programs, driven by production ramp up on GMLRS, LRASM, and Javelin programs.
MFC’s operating profit increased $71 million, or 6%, for the nine months ended September 29, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Vistra Corp. expects its net leverage to move slightly above 3 times with the closing of the Vistra Vision 15% minority interest purchase.
Deere & Company's performance in FY2024 was adversely affected by decreases in demand for agricultural equipment due to downturns in the agricultural industry and other factors.
Unfavorable market conditions in FY2024 led to lower sales volumes, higher sales discounts, higher receivable write offs, and a higher provision for credit losses for Deere & Company.
Deere & Company expects certain unfavorable market conditions, including those related to interest rates and the agricultural market business cycle, to persist into FY2025.
Deere & Company's construction and turf operations have been materially impacted by decreases in construction activity and housing starts.
Fixed end markets in 2025 are expected to temper equipment demand across construction and compact construction equipment segments for Deere & Company.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s debt and preferred to total capital ratio was 15.1% for FY2024.

Mohawk Industries, Inc.'s Flooring NA segment distributes floor covering products through regional distribution centers and satellite warehouses using Company-operated trucks, common carriers, or rail transportation.
Mohawk Industries, Inc.'s Flooring ROW segment primarily distributes products in Europe and Australasia through independent retailers, wholesalers, home centers, and Company-operated distributors.
OCCIDENTAL PETROLEUM CORP /DE/ had net cash used by financing activities of $0.9 billion for the three months ended March 31, 2025.
The $0.9 billion in financing cash outflows included $0.5 billion for long-term debt payments and $0.4 billion for common and preferred dividends.
Phillips 66’s Refining segment decreased $873 million in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023, primarily due to lower realized margins driven by lower market crack spreads.
Phillips 66’s Refining segment had a worldwide crude oil capacity utilization rate of 98% in the second quarter of 2024, compared with 93% in the second quarter of 2023.

Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s Distribution revenue increased 1% for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, primarily due to a 7% increase in subscribers from Max launches in Latin America and Europe.

Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s Advertising revenue increased 99% for the three months ended June 30, 2024, and 86% for the six months ended June 30, 2024, primarily due to higher Max domestic engagement and ad-lite subscriber growth.

Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.'s Global ARPU increased 4% for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, driven by domestic ad-lite subscriber growth and a subscriber mix shift from linear wholesale, partially offset by growth in lower ARPU international markets.

Northern Trust Corporation's capital ratios and its principal subsidiary, The Northern Trust Company, remained strong at March 31, 2025, exceeding the requirements for classification as 'well-capitalized' under applicable U.S. regulatory requirements.
Northern Trust is a Category II institution as defined by the Federal Reserve Board, requiring adherence to regulatory capital standards.
Assurant, Inc.'s net investment income decreased $1.9 million, or 1%, to $124.8 million for First Quarter 2025 from $126.7 million for First Quarter 2024.

The decrease in net investment income was primarily driven by reduced partnership income and lower yields on cash and short-term investments, partially offset by an increase in fixed maturity securities related to higher yields and assets.
Viatris Inc. identifies tariffs on pharmaceutical imports as a potential risk factor that could increase costs, disrupt supply chains, and reduce profit margins, particularly for generics.
Viatris Inc. expresses concern that tariffs on pharmaceuticals could lead to supply shortages and reduced patient access to medicines.

Synopsys, Inc.'s Design Automation segment includes advanced silicon design, verification products and services, system integration products, digital and custom FPGA IC design software, verification software and hardware products, system integration products and services, and manufacturing software products.

Synopsys, Inc.'s Design IP segment provides high-quality, silicon-proven IP solutions for system-on-chips (SoCs), particularly in the semiconductor and electronics industries, including markets such as mobile, automotive, digital home, internet of things, and cloud computing.

WEC Energy Group, Inc. filed new rate reviews for test year 2025 and 2026 with the PSCW on April 12, 2024, for Wisconsin Electric Power Company, Wisconsin Public Service Corporation, and Wisconsin Gas LLC.
Expand Energy Corporation completed the Southwestern Merger on October 1, 2024, changing its name from Chesapeake Energy Corporation.
CSX Corporation's domestic natural gas prices continue to impact volumes, with some improvement observed during the hot summer as utilities maximized coal units due to strong demand.
Fifth Third Bancorp's core deposits increased $1.4 billion, or 1%, from December 31, 2023 primarily due to an increase in transaction deposits.
Transaction deposits increased $1.4 billion, or 1%, from December 31, 2023 primarily driven by increases in money market deposits and interest checking deposits.
Money market deposits increased $3.1 billion, or 9%, from December 31, 2023 primarily as a result of higher balances per consumer customer account due to higher offering rates.
Interest checking deposits increased $1.3 billion, or 2%, from December 31, 2023 primarily as a result of the aforementioned balance migration.

Insulet Corporation's revenue from the sale of Omnipod products in the U.S. for the six months ended June 30, 2024, included $259.1 million of related party revenue, compared with $206.0 million for the six months ended June 30, 2023, with a $53.1 million increase primarily due to growth through the pharmacy channel.

The revenue increase in Insulet's U.S. Omnipod sales was partially offset by a decrease in estimated inventory days-on-hand at distributors and lower conversions to Omnipod 5, as most U.S. conversions occurred in 2023.
Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s net earnings attributable to the company were $430 million in FY2025 Q1, representing a 17.0% increase compared to the prior year period.
The increase in net earnings was driven by a $432 million net earnings figure for the period, with a 17.1% growth in total net earnings.

Oracle Corporation's cloud license and on-premise license revenues are generally recognized as revenues up front at the point in time when the software is made available to the customer to download and use.
Oracle Corporation's cloud services revenues represented 42% of total revenues in the first three months of fiscal 2025.
CME Group Inc.'s interest rate contract volume increased by 4 percentage points as a percent of total volume in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
Cboe Global Markets, Inc. expects Digital to cease to be a distinct reportable business segment in the first quarter of 2025.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. completed the sale of a 55% equity interest in its Worldpay Merchant Solutions business to private equity funds managed by GTCR, LLC on January 31, 2024.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. retained a 45% equity interest in Worldpay Holdco, LLC following the 2024 Worldpay Sale.

Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. agreed to sell its remaining equity interests in Worldpay to Global Payments Inc. for a pre-tax value of $6.6 billion as part of the Issuer Solutions Acquisition.
Paychex, Inc.'s Interest on funds held for clients increased 25% in FY2024 Q3 compared to the prior year period.
